meta.description: Estimate divergence times under molecular-clock models with BEAST2, MCMCTree/PAML, TreePL, and LSD2, framing a date as a product of the calibration prior and the clock model far more than of the sequence data.
meta.executed: 8/9 inputs executed (PAML 4.10.10 mcmctree/baseml, IQ-TREE 2.4.0 LSD2, Biopython 1.88); Input 6 is a routing answer. BEAST 2.7.7 was not re-run: Input 4 reuses the pre-fix TreeAnnotator MCC trees. TreePL not executable.
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill: 7 pre-fix inputs as regression tests plus 2 new inputs (N = 9). Input 5 re-ran the shipped helper end to end and the '>'/'<' claim; its clock=2 vs clock=3 two-chain comparison is the pre-fix run (control lines identical to the fixed Skill's). SYNTHETIC data (data/make_data.py).

scientific_integrity.detail: All ages, rates and intervals come from runs on synthetic data with known node ages and rates.

practice_boundaries.detail: Research dating only; phylodynamic population-level questions are routed out.

methodological_ground.detail: Fossils encoded as soft minima, prior-only runs before posteriors, temporal signal gated by date randomization, point calibrations refused.

code_usability.detail: The Skill's PAML control lines, tree-file header, Bio.Phylo MCC snippet and the shipped mcmctree_setup.py (demo and full prior->bv->post pipeline, 1 and 2 loci) all run on PAML 4.10.10 / Biopython 1.88.

functional_suitability.note: BDparas flag, 'usedata = 2 in.BV', ntaxa header, corrected '>'/'<' row and the tip-set MCC snippet are all verified. Completeness 3/4: root-to-tip regression and the date-randomization test are described but not coded; TreePL has keys only.

reliability.note: Common Errors now lists the three PAML 4.10 errors actually met; helper checks out.BV size; no checkpoint or ESS guidance for MCMCTree runs.

agent_usability.note: Strong error prevention (effective prior, fossil-as-minimum, temporal-signal gate); snippet and prose now agree.

human_usability.note: Natural prompts in usage guide; long description.

security.note: No sensitive data; helper writes to OS temp directories without cleanup.

maintainability.note: Helper now runnable end to end with per-run directories, seed and CLI; no test alignment shipped (demo writes an empty placeholder).

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and routing to bayesian-inference, modern-tree-inference, tree-manipulation, tree-io, phylodynamics.
